name: com.amd.schola
description: Reinforcement learning for Unity. Define agents, train them with Schola's Python tools (Gymnasium, Stable-Baselines3, RLlib), and run trained ONNX policies in your game.

samples.description: Train a cube to reach a target using Schola's Python PPO trainer, rewards, episode resets and the Unity training connection. See README.md in the imported sample.
